PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Most budget apps break the moment you go offline
PROBLEM_BODY:
They need a constant connection to sync with your bank, and they store your data on someone else's server. On a plane, on patchy signal, or if you simply don't want a bank link — they stop working.

FincWin is built the opposite way: your data lives in your browser, and the app works whether you're online or not.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Installs as a PWA on iOS, Android, Windows and Mac.
  • ✓Full offline use — every feature works with no connection.
  • ✓No bank login — add transactions manually or by CSV.
  • ✓Your data stays local — nothing on our servers.

FAQ_ITEMS:
Does FincWin really work with no internet?

Yes. Once loaded, it runs from your device. You can budget on a plane and it syncs nothing because there's nothing to sync — your data is already local.

Where is my data stored?

In your browser's local storage. Optionally you can back it up to your own Google Drive. FincWin keeps no copy.

Is it free?

Yes — the free plan is permanent. Pro ($39/year or $149 lifetime) adds CSV import and AI coaching.
